versions.changelog: Quickstart command with smart monitoring suggestions and engine status. Better first-run experience for agents.
Docs: global examples, no regional references
Fix: openclaw engine now works with watch command (skips initial fetch gracefully). Added --content-file to check command for feeding pre-fetched content.

OpenClaw engine for anti-bot sites. New --content-file flag on check command lets you feed pre-fetched content from any source. For sites like Takealot that block all headless browsers, set --engine openclaw and pipe content from OpenClaw browser tool.
v3.3.0: Cloudflare bypass with cloudscraper, smart engine fallback chain (curl -> cloudscraper -> playwright), engine status command
v3.2.1: Documentation rewrite. Professional, human-written docs.
v3.2.0: Interactive GUI console with monitor cards, price sparklines, alert history, group filtering, templates showcase. Dark/light mode. Zero dependencies.
Added feedback command (plain, --bug, --idea) with GitHub issue URL generation. Added debug command for system info. Added What's New message on first run after upgrade. Bumped version to 3.1.0.
v3.0.0: Smart change summaries, HTML visual diffs, multi-source price comparison, monitor templates, Playwright JS rendering, webhook notifications
v2.0.0: Dashboard, price trends, smart watch, groups, pause/resume, notes, weekly reports, export/import, smart diffs, CLI polish

Fix false positive price alerts on JS-heavy sites like Takealot. Price matching now requires actual currency symbols instead of grabbing random numbers from the page. Added JSON-LD and meta tag extraction for reliable e-commerce price detection. Sites behind Cloudflare or heavy JS now properly error out instead of silently matching garbage.

Initial release - track web pages for changes, price drops, stock availability, and custom conditions. Supports price thresholds, text contains/not-contains conditions, platform-aware selectors, snapshot history, and cron automation.
